column1: # Which documents and pitfalls belong to which stage of the roadmap.
# The roadmap index lists the projects of every stage, but it only had
# reading lists for stages one to four, so 48 of the 67 concept articles and
# 27 of the 37 pitfall articles could not be found from the index.
# A document is listed under the stage whose project teaches it. A pitfall is
# listed under the stage of the document it relates to. The stages from 17 to
# 26 hold variants of the three pattern families, so they point at the family
#   kind is "doc" or "pitfall"; the slug is the English file name.
